note: Verbatim LAMBDA definitions for the eHP stat layer, as exported from the sheet. Regenerate with scripts/extract-effective-paths.mjs and this fixture builder.

functions.EPH_ARMOR: LAMBDA(prim_bonus, has_ass, ass_bonus, stone_bac, lab_bac, prim_bonus*IF(has_ass, ((ass_bonus-1)*(1+stone_bac+lab_bac)*0.01)+1, 1))
functions.EPH_DABS:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, has_card, card_val, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, wse_lvl, has_perk, spb_lvl, relic_pct, vault_pct, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 1+0.03*lab_lvl,
  CARD, IF(has_card, card_val, 1),
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, 1+prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  WSE, 1+0.01*wse_lvl,
  PERKDABS, IF(has_perk, (1+0.15*5)*(1+1%*spb_lvl), 1),
  RELIC, 1+relic_pct,
  VAULT, 1+vault_pct,

WS*LAB*CARD*SUBSTAT*WSE*PERKDABS*RELIC*VAULT))
functions.EPH_DEF_PCT:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, has_card, card_val, has_mastery, mastery_lvl, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, has_perk, spb_lvl, relic_pct, vault_pct, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 0.2%*lab_lvl,
  CARD, IF(has_card, card_val+IF(has_mastery, 0.7%*(1+mastery_lvl), 0), 0),
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  PERKDEF, IF(has_perk, (4%*5)*(1+1%*spb_lvl), 0),
  RELIC, relic_pct,
  VAULT, vault_pct,

MIN(98%, WS+LAB+CARD+SUBSTAT+PERKDEF+RELIC+VAULT)))
functions.EPH_HEALTH:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, has_card, card_val, has_mastery, mastery_lvl, wse_lvl, has_perk, spb_lvl, has_cto, has_rto, relic_pct, vault_pct, has_dwhp, dwhp_lvl, disco, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 1+0.03*lab_lvl,
  CARD, IF(has_card, card_val*IF(has_mastery, 1+0.2*(1+mastery_lvl), 1), 1),
  WSE, 1+0.01*wse_lvl,
  PERKHP, IF(has_perk, (1+0.2*5)*(1+1%*spb_lvl), 1),
  CTO, IF(has_cto, 0.3, 1),
  RTO, IF(has_rto, 0.4, 1),
  RELIC, 1+relic_pct,
  VAULT, 1+vault_pct,
  DWHP, IF(has_dwhp, 500%+25%*dwhp_lvl, 1),

WS*LAB*CARD*WSE*PERKHP*CTO*RTO*RELIC*VAULT*DWHP*Disco))
functions.EPH_MAX_RCVR:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, wse_lvl, vault_pct, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 1%*lab_lvl,
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  WSE, 1+0.01*wse_lvl,
  VAULT, 1+vault_pct,

(WS+LAB+SUBSTAT)*WSE*VAULT))
functions.EPH_REGEN:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, has_card, card_val, has_mastery, mastery_lvl, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, wse_lvl, has_perk, spb_lvl, has_rgnto, has_rto, ito_lvl, relic_pct, vault_pct, has_swm, swm_lvl, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 1+0.03*lab_lvl,
  CARD, IF(has_card, card_val*IF(has_mastery, 1+0.4*(1+mastery_lvl), 1), 1),
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, 1+prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  WSE, 1+0.01*wse_lvl,
  PERKREGEN, IF(has_perk, (1+0.75*5)*(1+1%*spb_lvl), 1),
  RGNTO, IF(has_rgnto, 0.1, 1),
  RTO, IF(has_rto, 8*(1+1%*ito_lvl), 1),
  RELIC, 1+relic_pct,
  VAULT, 1+vault_pct,
  SWM, IF(has_swm, 1+0.9*(1+swm_lvl), 1),

WS*LAB*CARD*SUBSTAT*WSE*PERKREGEN*RGNTO*RTO*RELIC*VAULT*SWM))
functions.EPH_WALL_HEALTH:
LAMBDA(ws_val, lab_lvl, stone_sac, lab_sac, prim_sub, ass_sub, wse_lvl, prim_effect, ass_effect, fort_lvl, LET(
  WS, ws_val,
  LAB, 2%*lab_lvl,
  SAC, (1+stone_sac+lab_sac)*0.01,
  SUBSTAT, prim_sub+ass_sub*SAC,
  WSE, 1+0.01*wse_lvl,
  SF, IF(prim_effect+ass_effect<>0, prim_effect+ass_effect, 1),
    WALLHP, (WS+LAB+SUBSTAT)*WSE*SF,

  FORT, 1+0.2*fort_lvl,

WALLHP*FORT))
functions.EPH_WALL_REGEN:
LAMBDA(lab_lvl, prim_effect, ass_effect, LET(
  LAB, 10%*lab_lvl,
  SF, IF(prim_effect+ass_effect<>0, prim_effect+ass_effect, 1),

LAB*SF))
